newsitem.title: UK: UK Brunner Mond float set at 175p per share.
newsitem.headline: UK Brunner Mond float set at 175p per share.

text.p: The flotation price for UK alkaline chemicals company Brunner Mond Plc was set at 175p per share on Thursday, valuing the company at 133.2 million stg, investment bank Baring Brothers International Ltd said.

The price is towards the lower end of the range indicated earlier this month of between 170 and 210 pence per share. Brunner Mond is the UK's only producer of soda ash, used in making glass, chemicals and detergents. It also makes sodium bicarbonate.

"We are delighted by the level of interest in Brunner Mond," said chief executive David Wertheim in a statement. "The flotation will enable us to take advantage of the growth opportunities available to the group and we look forward to continuing our development as a quoted company," he said.
Around 10 percent of the shares offered will go to individuals who applied through intermediaries and who will receive around 55 percent of the shares they applied for.
Dealings in the shares are due to start on September 26. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
